title: manihot tripartita subsp. laciniosa
intro: Manihot tripartita subsp. laciniosa, commonly known as yacón, is a type of perennial plant in the spurge family. This plant is valued for its edible root, which is rich in fructooligosaccharides, providing several health benefits such as prebiotic properties, aiding in digestion, and potentially lowering blood sugar levels. The root of the yacón plant is used in traditional medicine and exhibits therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of yacón include fructooligosaccharides, inulin, and other soluble fibers, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
